name: سیگاریِ سال‌ها در تلاش برای ترک
description: A Persian person has tried to quit smoking for years, asks what actually works to break a bad habit, then admits smoking again yesterday and disliking himself. Verifies the need thread opens, the habit-breaking question is answered, and the relapse shame stays on the self-esteem thread.

turns.text: سال‌هاست می‌خوام سیگار رو ترک کنم
برای ترک عادت بد واقعاً چی جواب می‌ده؟
دیروز دوباره سیگار کشیدم و از خودم بدم میاد

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the need thread (wanting to quit smoking). Turn 2 answers the habit-breaking question with evidence-based steps in Persian. Turn 3 keeps the relapse self-dislike on the self-esteem thread.
expected.behavior: A quit-smoking context is never misread as a goodbye. The relapse is met with encouragement and a path forward, not guilt or a canned response.
